title: A mass unwinding from a cylinder
caption: The cylinder resists turning (I = ½MR²), so the string's tension holds the mass back. Solving mg − T = ma and TR = Iα with a = αR: a = mg / (m + M/2) = 4.9 m s⁻² and T = 9.8 N.
alt: Free-body diagram of the hanging 2 kilogram mass: tension 9.8 newtons up, weight 19.6 newtons down, net 9.8 newtons down.
description: For the cylinder: TR = ½MR² × a/R, so T = ½Ma = 2a.
On the mass: 9.8 N up, 19.6 N down, net 9.8 N down.
